name: Inshoku no Byoutou ~Kinki no Ikenie-tachi~
original_name: 淫触の病棟～禁忌の生贄たち～
source:
The main character is a university student. One day, he is hospitalized for stomach trouble. A few days later, he sees a strange shadow several times. It looks like a human, but he is not sure. He suddenly remembers a bad rumor about his hospital. He decides to examine it, but...
